newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - June 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - June 2.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tension rises between Israel and Palestinians over land dealers.
- Qatar studies Bahrain's calls for unity. The two Gulf Arab states are locked in a territorial dispute over a number of small islands.
- Saudi Radwan engineering company wins a 110 million riyal contract to build a commercial complex in the holy city of Medina.
- Iran, Oman agree to develop first joint oilfield.
- Ciller to replace Turkish Prime Minister Erbakan, calls for an early election.
- Saudi-Egyptian committee to meet on June 10 in Cairo to review trade exchanges.
- Jordanian firm plans to build 10,000 flats at a cost of 82 million dinars.
- Kuwaiti stocks drop for the second day running in a correction move.
